note: Curated role catalog. Bundled with the plugin and read in place - deliberately NOT copied into ~/.config/vangio/, so a reinstall can never overwrite user edits. Every `picks` entry is a candidate, not a promise: it is checked against the live model catalog at read time, and anything that has been retired is dropped and logged once. A role exists here only when it needs a different model CAPABILITY - not merely a different instruction. 'Documenter', 'reviewer' and 'tester' are a warrior with a different prompt, so they are not roles.

king.title: King
king.summary: Plans, decides, reviews and delegates. Every paradigm has exactly one, and it is never optional.

picks.why: 1M context - holds the whole plan plus every delegation result without compacting
200k context and fast; the long-standing default
1M context, 393k output - the best king available once an NVIDIA key is set

warrior.title: Warrior
warrior.summary: Produces the artifact - code, documentation, copy, whatever this paradigm makes. The binding constraint is output ceiling, not context: a 32k cap truncates real work.

picks.why: 262k output - the best free ceiling anywhere on the index
131k+ output; single-concurrent by contract, so never use it on a parallel head
262k context and 262k output once an NVIDIA key is set

scout.title: Scout
scout.summary: Finds things - lookups, research, reconnaissance. Many small calls with short answers, so cheapness and speed matter far more than either limit.

picks.why: 190k context, 64k output - the closest thing to a small fast free model on Zen
200k context; useful as a second scout when fanning out
256k context - reaches for a scout that has to read a lot before answering

seer.title: Seer
seer.summary: Looks at images - mockups, screenshots, design exports - and turns them into words the other heads can use. The only role defined by a modality rather than a limit, because no prompt can make a text-only model see.

picks.why: the ONLY free model on the index that accepts images
262k context and output with image input, once an NVIDIA key is set
